messages.author: 9c1a93cd557f488e
messages.subject: FAMD or PCA error message
parts:
Hi all-

I ran my FAMD code fine but in trying to use dimdesc, i get this error message that I haven't been able to find online:

"Error in dimdesc(Res2) : non convenient data"

Does anyone know what this means?

Thanks
Laura

messages.author: 91fcdff1323a6831
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: FAMD or PCA error message
parts:
Hi Laura,

Perhaps someone else might be familiar with your FAMD code (or dimdesc), but it's hard to help if we don't have a short bit of reproducible code to at least test.

If you copy a subset of your dataframe using  dput() and paste that into an email along with the code you are trying to run, it will give folks a better shot at troubleshooting/solving your problem.

Thanks,
Ryan
